title: Filtered presentations of small diagrams
statement: Use universes, coherent functor categories, nerves, colimits, accessibility and compactness from [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\lambda<\kappa$ be infinite regular cardinals in the smaller universe, with $\kappa$ uncountable and $\mu^\nu<\kappa$ whenever $\mu<\kappa$ and $\nu<\lambda$. Let $\mathcal C$ be both $\lambda$-accessible and $\kappa$-accessible and let $K$ be a $\kappa$-small simplicial set. Then $\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)$ is $\kappa$-accessible. Every diagram $p:K\to\mathcal C$ is a colimit in this functor category of a diagram $q:N(A)\to\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)$ indexed by a small $\kappa$-filtered partially ordered set $A$, with $q(a)(v)$ $\kappa$-compact for every $a\in A$ and every vertex $v$ of $K$. Each diagram whose values are $\kappa$-compact is $\kappa$-compact as an object of $\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)$.

source.place: Proof of Proposition 5.4.4.3, printed p. 434, with its two cardinals denoted here by λ and κ; Proposition 5.3.4.13 for compactness, and Proposition 5.3.1.18 for replacement of a filtered index by a filtered poset. These are exactly the presentations used in Lemma 5.5.4.14, printed pp. 481-482.
